action: Implement CONTEXT.md D7 (audit A-doctrine.md findings F5 and F21). In budget.rs set TRAILER_LINE to: Everything above is already read — do not re-fetch it. Run `.bee/bin/bee orient` when you route work (claim, plan, change phase); run `.bee/bin/bee status --json` only for detail this block does not carry. Remove the Proof-per-change-type line the preamble prints (near budget.rs:767) and anything that only builds it. Update every existing test in session_preamble/tests.rs that pins the old trailer or that line. No new tests (stdi-2 owns them). Proof: the cell verify; quote the counts. Rules for every cell: keep every rule and its why-clause (agents-block-diet D6); keep test-pinned wording unless this action names the pin; never add a size limit (D1). Write no code comments. Plain English, short sentences. Allowed bee commands: the cell verify, .bee/bin/bee knowledge check, .bee/bin/bee knowledge search. Do not run any bee dispatch or herding verb, not even its help. Run only the cell verify, never the full suite. Commit only the files of this cell, one commit, trailer cell: <id>.
